submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, Cu0.56Fe0.12V0.31 gave the highest photocurrent: 1.4e-7 A. That is about 3x the V-rich CuV2O6-like point (#58) and about 5x the Cu3Fe4V6O24-like point (#200). This fits the known photoanode activity of Cu-rich Cu vanadates (Cu3V2O8/Cu2V2O7 type) near the 2.06 eV illumination energy.

rejected.reason: V-rich, low-Fe CuV2O6-like region; measured 5e-8 A, below the Cu-rich point
